svg.title: FORGE Operations Intelligence - Azure solution architecture
svg.desc: Manufacturing operations users access a React and TypeScript frontend over public HTTPS. Azure Container Apps hosts the frontend and Python FastAPI backend together. The backend reads and writes local SQLite demo persistence inside the same Container App, and authenticates to Microsoft Foundry using Azure Managed Identity. Foundry project manufacturing-operations-01 uses GPT-4.1-mini for the Downtime Investigation Agent and Maintenance Advisor Agent. SQLite is not production-grade durable storage; container restart or replacement may lose all demo state. AI-generated recommendations require human review and approval.
svg.metadata: Official Azure service icons: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center, Azure Public Service Icons V24. https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/icons/ . Used under Microsoft's architecture-diagram icon terms. Browser, Container Apps Environments, Managed Identities, and Microsoft Foundry artwork is embedded without alteration.
svg.text: From downtime signals to evidence-linked investigations and human-reviewed maintenance plans.
Single Container App / shared web origin
Local SQLite is not production-grade durable storage. Container restart or replacement may lose all state.
Synthetic manufacturing data only. AI outputs require human review and approval; no autonomous equipment control.
Runtime architecture only / build and deployment services intentionally omitted
Azure service icons: Microsoft / Azure Architecture Center
